run_iterate_in_subprocess: run an iterable function in a separate subprocess with configurable buffer size and timeout
create_subprocess_iterable: create a SubprocessIterable that reuses a worker subprocess across multiple iterations
test_iterate_in_subprocess_timeout: test iterate_in_subprocess with a timeout to terminate the process on inactivity
review_ipc_terminate: review the _ipc dataclass terminate method that aborts and drains the subprocess queues
refactor_join_process: refactor the _join helper to gracefully terminate or kill a stuck worker process
